short_answer: Outside the election and sport, three conversations moved this week in South Africa: Sunday 'seven colours' plate ratings on TikTok and X, the 'Not in my kitchen, Sipho' voice-note meme out of Durban, and people rewearing their Heritage Day outfits after 24 September. Seven colours posts ran at 3.1 times their usual daily count on Sunday 27 September.

claims.text: On Sunday 27 September, people across TikTok and X posted their Sunday lunch plates as 'seven colours' and asked others to rate them, at 3.1 times the usual daily count of #7colours posts.
claims.label: corroborated

quotes.text: I can't be the only one who puts beetroot right next to the chakalaka
Rate my 7 colours honestly, the butternut is doing the most

numbers.unit: times usual daily #7colours posts (27 September against the 28-day daily median)

claims.text: A voice note of a Durban woman telling someone called Sipho to leave her kitchen became a meme format: creators on TikTok and X reused the line 'Not in my kitchen, Sipho' over their own clips and captions from 24 September.
claims.label: corroborated

quotes.text: Not in my kitchen, Sipho. Not today, not ever.
my manager asking for the report before 9: not in my kitchen, Sipho

claims.text: Heritage Day outfits are getting a second outing: two unrelated accounts posted their 24 September looks again later in the week under #heritagefits, which suggests a rewear angle may be forming, though two posts are not yet a trend.
claims.label: inferred

so_what.text: Food and grocery brands can join the seven colours ratings on Sunday afternoons with their own plate, as long as they take the rating as a joke and do not correct anyone's plate; the moment passes by Monday.
The Sipho line is a free-to-use refusal format, but it belongs to one family's voice note; a brand should reply in the format rather than lift the audio, and should not name a real Sipho.
A retailer with a rewear or repair message could invite Heritage Day outfit reposts, but should wait for more than two posts before building on it.

watch_next.text: Whether #7colours posts return next Sunday at more than twice the daily median, or fall back after one weekend.
Likely to spread to Facebook family groups within a week as a reshared voice note; this is a forecast, not an observation.
Count #heritagefits rewear posts through 5 October to see whether the angle holds.
